Hi Samir —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We'd like to schedule an initial discovery call to connect our AE/SE pair with your champion and engineering lead so we can:

- Understand the primary latency and throughput goals for the inference workload
- Walk through network/security constraints (VPC, egress, KMS) and procurement timeline
- Agree on a 60–75 minute demo + technical deep dive timebox

Proposed windows (PDT):
1) Wed 19 Aug — 09:30–10:45
2) Wed 19 Aug — 14:00–15:15
3) Thu 20 Aug — 11:00–12:15

If none of these work, send a couple alternatives and I’ll loop in Karthik (SE) and Marissa (Customer Success / procurement handoff). We’ll attach a short agenda and the IT checklist ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Irene Choi

irene.choi@redwood-inference.com | +1 415-555-0123
